title: OpenViking workspace configuration (v1)
description: Schema for <workspace-root>/.openviking/config.json and config.local.json, and for the `settings` object of a ~/.openviking/workspaces/<slot>.json registry entry. Connection and credential settings belong in ovcli.conf and the environment; a workspace file that names one has it stripped with a warning.

$schema.description: Ignored by the client; present so editors can validate and complete this file.

version.description: Schema major version. A file declaring anything else is skipped with a warning rather than guessed at.

min_client_version.description: Advisory only — a mismatch warns and never blocks, so a committed file cannot deny service to an older plugin.

notes.description: Free text for whoever reads the file. Not interpreted.

source.description: How to derive the peer id. A preset, a template, or a list of templates tried in order — a template naming an empty variable falls through to the next. The `git` default resolves only inside a repository; anywhere else it resolves to nothing and no peer is sent, so name such a directory with `id` or derive one with `cwd`. Variables: {git_remote} (normalized origin, e.g. github.com-org-repo), {git_root} (the enclosing repository root, empty outside one) and {cwd} (paths, legacy sanitation), {dir} (the workspace root's directory name, empty when the directory is not a workspace) and {harness} (the name of the agent running, never empty; no preset uses it, so agents share one repository's memory unless a template asks otherwise).

id.description: An explicit peer id, which wins over `source`. Two directories carrying the same id share one memory, which makes this the way to name a directory that is not a git repository. Must match the server's identifier rule.

peer_scope.description: `all` also sweeps the other peers under this user, demoted in ranking; `actor` searches only this workspace's own peer.

session_patterns.description: Matched against both the session id and the working directory. `*` does not cross `/`; use `**` for that. Lists union across layers — a leading "!reset" clears what lower layers contributed.

labels.description: Free-form metadata for humans and for the plugins' doctor output. Its keys are the user's own vocabulary and are never interpreted as settings.
